notes: Restraint only. Four kinds kept as planned. Mussel PDOs/TSG (Galicia, bouchot, Mont-Saint-Michel bouchot, Scardovari, Novigrad), Taranto black mussel and Wakkad Tigri mussels kept. Geoduck moved from a model to a clam type; Roman Coastline Tellina and the Ōno asari GI kept; Korean Suncheon Bay razor clam GI kept with its original name. Nothing dropped; no new kinds, no web research.
